name: Chemistry of Life
summary: The chemistry a biologist needs: bonds, water, pH, carbon compounds and the structure of the four families of biological macromolecules.

topics.name: Elements of life, atomic structure and isotopes (including radioisotopes in biology)
Covalent, ionic and hydrogen bonds; van der Waals and hydrophobic interactions
Properties of water: cohesion, heat capacity, solvent behaviour
Acids, bases, pH and biological buffers
Carbon chemistry and the main functional groups
Condensation and hydrolysis: building and breaking polymers
Proteins: amino acids, peptide bonds and the four levels of structure
Nucleic acids: nucleotides, DNA and RNA
Energy, free energy and chemical reactions in cells (introductory)
Enzymes as catalysts: active site, substrate and denaturation
